def backend.optsVal (v : go_etcd_io.bbolt.Options) (o : backend.OptsM) : Prop :=
  ∃ f,
    (BitVec.toNat f = 0 ∨ BitVec.toNat f = bbolt.mapPopulate) ∧
      bbolt.optsVal v (o.toBolt false f) ∧
        v.Timeout' = o.timeout ∧ v.NoFreelistSync' = o.noFreelistSync ∧ v.InitialMmapSize' = o.initialMmapSize

def backend.boltOpenOptionsOk : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ p,
      typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.boltOpenOptions) p DFrac.discard ∗

def backend.OptsM.ok [GoGlobalContext] (o : backend.OptsM) : Prop :=
  o.readOnly = false ∧ o.pageSize = W64 0 ∧ o.openFile = func.nil ∧ backend.loggerPtrOk o.logger

def backend.optsAt (l : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (o : backend.OptsM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ v, typedPointsto l v dq ∗ ⌜backend.optsVal v o⌝)

theorem backend.optsZero_ok [GoGlobalContext] : backend.optsZero.ok

structure backend.OptsM : Type where
  readOnly : Bool
  pageSize : w64
  openFile : GoFunc
  logger : GoInterface
  timeout : w64
  noFreelistSync : Bool
  initialMmapSize : w64

theorem backend.boltOpenOptionsOk_persistent : Persistent backend.boltOpenOptionsOk

def backend.loggerPtrOk [GoGlobalContext] : GoInterface → Prop :=
  match x✝ with
  | GoInterface.nil => True
  | GoInterface.ok li => ∃ t l, li.ty = t.PointerType ∧ li.v = intoVal l

def backend.OptsM.toBolt (o : backend.OptsM) (m : Bool) (f : w64) : bbolt.OptsM :=
  { readOnly := o.readOnly, pageSize := o.pageSize, openFile := o.openFile, logger := o.logger, mlock := m,
    mmapFlags := f }

def backend.OptsM.noErr (o : backend.OptsM) : Prop :=
  o.timeout = W64 0 ∧ o.noFreelistSync = true ∧ sint.Z o.initialMmapSize ≤ 281474976710655
